{{Quote|While you were gone, kidnappers grabbed Doctor Tarnis.|Agent Galen|<ref name="Kidnapped" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]], near the end of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the undercover [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]] arranged for the '''kidnapping''' of his Republic [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] alter ego Eli Tarnis by the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate. With Tarnis's inside information, the criminal [[Zeer (criminal)|Zeer]] and his team infiltrated the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and retrieved the [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] in the heavily-guarded structure. While Zeer and his men served as a distraction by [[Skirmish in Docking Bay 84|barricading]] themselves in [[Docking Bay 84]] of the nearby [[Coruscant Spaceport]], Tarnis then escaped to the [[Justicar territory|territory]] of his allies in the paramilitary [[Justicars' Brigade]] and continued his plans to acquire the [[Planet Prison]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Tarnis! We risked everything for you. Stealing those data files, faking your kidnapping&hellip; this is how you repay us?''"<br />"''You were compensated with enough weapons and armor to make Black Sun invincible.|Salarr and Tarnis, on Black Sun's aid to the Sith|<ref name="Rescue">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Rescue|Coruscant}}</ref>}}
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] sensed a disturbance in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and dispatched the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bela Kiwiiks]] and her [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Kira Carsen]], to investigate.<ref name="Enemy Force">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Enemy Force|Tython}}</ref> Kiwiiks was able to confirm the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark presence]] on the capital,<ref name="Weapon of the Jedi">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Weapon of the Jedi|Tython}}</ref> though she was unaware that its source was in fact the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]], who was posing as a Republic [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] named Eli Tarnis on the [[Republic superweapon initiative]]. Sensing that his position was compromised, Tarnis contacted the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]] and [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicates,<ref name="Rescue" /> and arranged for the [[Raid on a Republic Military warehouse|theft]] of the design files for Tarnis's project, the [[Planet Prison]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]],<ref name="Stolen Secrets" /> in order to draw potential suspicion away from himself.<ref name="Rescue" />

When a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]], the former apprentice of Jedi Master [[Orgus Din]], was [[Raid on the Migrant Merchants' Guild warehouse|sent to retrieve]] the files from the criminals in the [[Old Galactic Market]] region,<ref name="Stolen Secrets" /> Tarnis contacted Black Sun's leader, [[Salarr]]. In exchange for Imperial weapons and technology, Tarnis requested that Black Sun conduct his "kidnapping" so that he could escape the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] without suspicion and continue with his plans to acquire the Planet Prison.<ref name="Kidnapped" />

==The kidnapping==
{{Quote|This is the most secure building on Coruscant. It's full of guards.''"<br />"''Guards never stood a chance. Whoever the kidnappers are, they knew right where to hit us.|The Jedi Knight and Galen|<ref name="Kidnapped" />}}
[[File:Eli_Tarnis.png|thumb|right|170px|Doctor Tarnis, the kidnapping's target]]
With inside information supplied by Tarnis, a team of Black Sun criminals under the leadership of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Zeer (criminal)|Zeer]] infiltrated the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] Building, incapacitating<ref name="Kidnapped" /> the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]] and [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] personnel guarding the building,<ref name="Codex" /> and Tarnis was quickly extracted by Zeer's team before alarms were raised.<ref name="Kidnapped" />

However, the Security forces and agents of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]], the Republic's intelligence agency, quickly realized that Tarnis was missing. SIS [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Galen (SIS)|Galen]] immediately ordered Kira Carsen to lead a team of Coruscant Security officers to the nearby [[Coruscant Spaceport]] in pursuit of the kidnappers.<ref name="Kidnapped" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Kira led a security team in pursuit, but the kidnappers split up during the chase&mdash;hang on. Signal coming in&hellip;''"<br />"''Agent Galen! I've got these creeps pinned down&mdash;but they won't surrender!|Agent Galen receives Carsen's message|<ref name="Kidnapped" />}}
Tarnis left Zeer's group at the [[Senate Plaza/Legends|Senate Plaza]] and took an [[Air taxi/Legends|air taxi]] to [[Black Sun territory]] as planned,<ref name="Kidnapped" /> though he diverted his taxi to [[Justicar territory]], a region of Coruscant under the control of the Imperial-friendly paramilitary [[Justicars' Brigade]], where he continued his plans to acquire the Planet Prison itself.<ref name="Rescue" /> Zeer and his team barricaded themselves in [[Docking Bay 84]] of the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] as a distraction, though Carsen and the CSF officers eventually [[Skirmish in Docking Bay 84|broke]] the criminals' lines with the aid of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who had been sent to retrieve the stolen design files.<ref name="Kidnapped" /> The Knight was later sent on a [[Raid on the Black Sun headquarters|mission]] to rescue Tarnis from Black Sun territory, though Tarnis's deception and true identity was revealed during the rescue attempt.<ref name="Rescue" />

==Behind the scenes==
Doctor Tarnis's kidnapping is first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]], at the end of the Jedi Knight class mission "Stolen Secrets."<ref name="Stolen Secrets" /> The subsequent mission, "Kidnapped," deals with the pursuit of Tarnis's captors,<ref name="Kidnapped" /> but it is not revealed until the following mission, "The Rescue," that Tarnis himself orchestrated the kidnapping.<ref name="Rescue" />
